main_text.head: IISDEM.

p.l: QVum tumulo lateat Melior Volmarius isto,
Næquenihil melius Meliore, nec India quidquā

main_text.head: SIMONIS GRYNÆI; MAGNI cognome in omni eruditionis genere adepti: bonarum artium in Academia Basilienfi Profefforis, Memoriæ.
main_text.p: ECquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Nympha, Tingitis imbre genas largo, Rhenūq; per omne Turbata, magno repletis littora planctu? Ecquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Phœbe, Sublatum esse gemis, quæ par tibi cura sodalem Fecerat, & simile adiunctum cognome Vtrique? Ecquid nunc iaculatur aquas nimbosus Orion? Et madidam fundit lacrymosus Aquarius urnā? Caterāque obscuro radiantia sidera cælo Illustres tingunt nigra ferrugine vultus? Ecquid ad extincti Grynaei funera, Vates Deiecti mœrore oculos, lacrymantia verba, Et mœsto alternos trahitis de pectore versus? O rerum fortes varia, properatáque doctis Semper

page.notes: Lower half of the first verse column and the lower-left Latin lines are partly obscured by a strike-through and stains; "lacrymosus" and "Aquarius" read with some uncertainty. The woodcut-style large initials Q and E are joined to their words. The bottom line "Semper" is set right-aligned.
